item.tib: bla ma'i sgrub pa bsam 'phel nor bu'i rgyan
item.coloph: de ltar rnam dag 'gyur med yan lag bdun pa 'di / mnyam med skyes mchog 'dul ba rgyal mtshan gyis / dpon gsas bla ma mya ngan 'das dus su bstod tshig dbyangs dang bcas nas bstod pa'o
item.note: dpon-gsas bla-ma, as found in the colophon, is identified as 'gro-mgon blo-gros in ntkc (tibetan version, p. 24, line 16). the appended pages 187-199 do not belong to this text. these are verses of praise occasioned by the death of the author's teacher, 'a-zha blo-gros rgyal-mtshan. the author belonged to the bru clan.
